name: Trailer Preroll
description: Plays a cinema-style pre-show of trailers (from your own library and upcoming releases) before movies and TV episodes. Trailers are fetched with yt-dlp into a small, rotating local cache and served from two auto-created libraries.
overview: Cinema-style trailer prerolls before movies and TV.

versions.changelog: Fixes the settings page styling that didn't apply in 1.5.0.0 (pill tabs, language dropdown and cached-trailer cards now render); cached trailers load automatically as bordered cards.
Pill-style tabbed settings with a native-style language dropdown; cached-trailer manager (Library/Upcoming) with per-trailer Replace; removes ghost/duplicate library items left behind by rotation.
Change-trailer button on the web player (removes a trailer you don't want and fetches a different one); play-count list now shows trailer names for rotated-out trailers instead of raw ids.
Scheduled task (Dashboard > Scheduled Tasks) to control when trailers cache, daily by default; language filter to skip foreign-language films; removed the always-on hourly background run.
One-click yt-dlp/deno installer; de-duplicate trailers by title; auto-apply posters (library films and upcoming via TMDB); trailer play-count viewer.
Broaden compatibility to all Jellyfin 10.11.x; add tool-setup diagnostics (yt-dlp/deno/ffmpeg) to the status panel; skip duplicate Watch Later entries.
